About this item

  • Upgraded Height-Adjustable 2D Linkage Armrests: Unlike traditional fixed-height linkage armrests, these armrests adjust vertically to better match your body and desk height. This helps your elbows rest naturally and reduces shoulder and arm fatigue, especially for taller users who often find standard armrests too low. They also move with the backrest to keep your arms supported as you recline while gaming, working, or relaxing
  • Massage Lumbar Support – Stay Comfortable in Long Gaming or Work Sessions: Lower back pain is the #1 complaint from gamers and office workers. Our Ergonomic Gaming Chair with Massage Lumbar Pillow delivers soothing support that keeps your spine aligned during long gaming sessions, streaming, or working from home.
  • Spring Cushion Seat – No More Flat, Hard Seats: Unlike chairs that go flat after a few weeks, the Spring Cushion Seat with high-density foam stays supportive. Perfect when you need to sit through competitive esports matches or late-night study sessions without discomfort.
  • 150° Recline & Adjustable Headrest – Switch from Focus to Relaxation: When it’s time to relax, recline back up to 150°. Adjust the headrest and lumbar pillow to find the perfect fit for your posture, whether you’re watching streams, working at your desk, or taking a quick break.
  • Heavy Duty 330lbs Build – Stable, Safe, Certified: This Heavy Duty Gaming Chair supports up to 330lbs, built with an aluminum five-star base, SGS-certified gas lift, and smooth rolling casters. No wobbling, no squeaks—just reliable stability for your gaming setup or home office.
  • 【FSC-Certified】The frame of this gaming chair made of FSC-Certified wood

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the gaming chair easy to assemble with clear instructions and appreciate its value for money, with one noting it works well for both gaming and driving games. The chair provides good back support that remains supportive even after long hours, and customers like its reclining mechanism, with one mentioning it can recline to a nearly flat position. The cushioning receives mixed feedback, with some finding the material soft while others say it's too hard, and stability is also mixed, with customers noting it rolls easily on carpet.

5 out of 5 stars
Rock solid, whisper quiet, and a lifesaver for office naps!
I’m really impressed with this chair. Assembly was a breeze because the instructions were clear, and I had it put together in no time. Right out of the box, you can tell the hardware has some serious weight to it since nothing feels cheap or flimsy. Once assembled, it feels super sturdy with great weight support. Best of all, there’s zero creaking or squeaking when you shift around or lean back. The pull-out footrest is the real game-changer, though. Being able to kick back and take a quick nap in the office is insanely comfortable. Totally worth it!

    This slim and efficient computer chair is exactly what I needed. Feels great and keeps you focused at your desk like a good gamer chair should. The lay back feature is almost good enough to take a nap in, seriously I almost fell asleep! When locked in at the normal height it gets work done better than those bigger CEO chairs, by far better. The only drawback is you can't really rock back on it. Instead you can go back and lock that in but once locked you lose the rocking feature. Not a huge drawback but my old chair rocked and I kinda liked that feature. I love the colors and the little extra lumbar supports it comes with. Overall a very solid chair and built to last. It also fits next to my computer better than my last chair so I have to give it high parise for that. You really can't go wrong at this price, my last chair cost 3x more and it didn't last more than a few years before the seat wear down to nothing, this chair is built to last longer I can already tell.

    Color: White Black
    Verified Purchase

    This slim and efficient computer chair is exactly what I needed. Feels great and keeps you focused at your desk like a good gamer chair should. The lay back feature is almost good enough to take a nap in, seriously I almost fell asleep! When locked in at the normal height it gets work done better than those bigger CEO chairs, by far better. The only drawback is you can't really rock back on it. Instead you can go back and lock that in but once locked you lose the rocking feature. Not a huge drawback but my old chair rocked and I kinda liked that feature. I love the colors and the little extra lumbar supports it comes with. Overall a very solid chair and built to last. It also fits next to my computer better than my last chair so I have to give it high parise for that. You really can't go wrong at this price, my last chair cost 3x more and it didn't last more than a few years before the seat wear down to nothing, this chair is built to last longer I can already tell.

About this Item

  • Upgraded Height-Adjustable 2D Linkage Armrests: Unlike traditional fixed-height linkage armrests, these armrests adjust vertically to better match your body and desk height. This helps your elbows rest naturally and reduces shoulder and arm fatigue, especially for taller users who often find standard armrests too low. They also move with the backrest to keep your arms supported as you recline while gaming, working, or relaxing
  • Massage Lumbar Support – Stay Comfortable in Long Gaming or Work Sessions: Lower back pain is the #1 complaint from gamers and office workers. Our Ergonomic Gaming Chair with Massage Lumbar Pillow delivers soothing support that keeps your spine aligned during long gaming sessions, streaming, or working from home.
  • Spring Cushion Seat – No More Flat, Hard Seats: Unlike chairs that go flat after a few weeks, the Spring Cushion Seat with high-density foam stays supportive. Perfect when you need to sit through competitive esports matches or late-night study sessions without discomfort.
  • 150° Recline & Adjustable Headrest – Switch from Focus to Relaxation: When it’s time to relax, recline back up to 150°. Adjust the headrest and lumbar pillow to find the perfect fit for your posture, whether you’re watching streams, working at your desk, or taking a quick break.
  • Heavy Duty 330lbs Build – Stable, Safe, Certified: This Heavy Duty Gaming Chair supports up to 330lbs, built with an aluminum five-star base, SGS-certified gas lift, and smooth rolling casters. No wobbling, no squeaks—just reliable stability for your gaming setup or home office.
  • 【FSC-Certified】The frame of this gaming chair made of FSC-Certified wood

Product Description

Experience upgraded comfort with our Ergonomic Gaming Chair with Footrest and Massage Lumbar Support, now designed with a Leather Mesh Hybrid finish for the perfect balance of durability and breathability. The spring cushion seat, adjustable headrest pillow, and massage lumbar support keep you comfortable for hours while improving posture and reducing back pain—ideal for esports players, streamers, or office professionals who spend long hours seated. Unlike standard PU-only chairs, this Breathable Leather Mesh Gaming Chair combines premium PU leather with ventilated mesh panels to provide airflow and reduce overheating during intense matches or study sessions. With a 150° reclining function, adjustable height, and customizable support, it easily adapts to your needs—whether you’re working at your desk, live streaming, or relaxing after a long day. Built with a heavy duty frame, aluminum five-star base, SGS-certified gas lift, and smooth rolling casters, this 330lbs capacity hybrid gaming chair offers stability and durability you can trust. The racing style design enhances your gaming setup while delivering long-lasting comfort. Say goodbye to wobbly frames, poor lumbar support, and sweaty, uncomfortable chairs—this Professional Esports Gaming Chair was made to solve the pain points gamers care about most.
